_note: Impact Radius. Key: archetype_key -> tier (dominant/present/subtle). Subtle is static.
subtle: This catalytic current runs quietly in your chart—present as a subtle energetic influence, but not a dominant force in this portrait.
fallback: Your Impact Radius highlights your innate ability to naturally alter the trajectories of those around you. While this specific signature is complex, it reveals a profound capacity to spark transformation simply through your presence. Trust your ability to be an agent of change, recognizing that you often leave people and environments fundamentally shifted just by passing through.

the_awakener.dominant: As the Awakener, your Impact Radius operates as a sudden, paradigm-shattering force. You do not just inspire change; your mere presence acts as a seismic event that breaks people out of stagnant routines and outdated beliefs. People often experience unexpected, rapid shifts in their own lives shortly after entering your orbit. The shadow of this archetype is the projection of chaos. Because you trigger necessary but destabilizing awakenings, others may unfairly blame you for the sudden upheaval they are experiencing, making you feel like a walking lightning rod for conflict. Your growth edge is learning to initiate the awakening without taking responsibility for the ensuing storm. You are the catalyst, not the caretaker. Trust that the paradigms you shatter were already fragile, and allow others to rebuild their own foundations.
the_awakener.present: You carry the signature of the Awakener, meaning your presence naturally acts as a seismic force that breaks others out of stagnant paradigms. People often experience sudden, unexpected shifts in their own trajectories simply by entering your orbit. Your invitation is to trust your role as an agent of change while remembering you are not responsible for managing the fallout of their awakening.
the_awakener.fallback: As the Awakener, your chart highlights a powerful capacity to shatter outdated paradigms. You are a natural disruptor of stagnation, bringing sudden and necessary change to the people and environments you encounter. Trust your ability to wake others up, acting as a vital catalyst for transformation simply by existing in your authenticity.

the_mirror.dominant: As the Mirror, your Impact Radius is characterized by radical, unrelenting reflection. You possess the intense energetic capacity to force others to confront their unhealed wounds, hidden desires, and deepest inauthenticities simply by standing in front of them. You don't have to say a word; your energy demands truth. The shadow of this archetype is the danger of becoming the scapegoat. When people are unprepared to face their own reflections, they will often project their discomfort, defensiveness, and anger onto you, attacking the mirror rather than examining themselves. Your growth edge is radical detachment. You must polish the glass and stand firm in your authenticity, but absolutely refuse to absorb the emotional weight of what others see in you. Their reaction to their reflection is not your burden to carry.
the_mirror.present: Operating as the Mirror, your presence naturally forces those around you to confront their own unhealed truths and inauthenticities. You act as a profound catalyst for self-awareness in others, simply by existing in your own truth. Your challenge is to maintain your reflective clarity without absorbing the defensive projections or emotional discomfort of those who are not yet ready to face themselves.
the_mirror.fallback: As the Mirror, your chart reveals a profound capacity to reflect truth back to the world. You naturally demand authenticity from those around you, acting as a catalyst for deep self-awareness and healing. Trust your ability to hold up the glass, using your presence to help others clearly see who they truly are.

the_catalyst.dominant: As the Catalyst, your Impact Radius makes you a literal walking plot point in the lives of others. Your energy is inherently transformative; people are often destined to change directions, leave relationships, or start new lives shortly after crossing paths with you. You accelerate the timeline of everyone you meet. The shadow of this archetype is the deep exhaustion of transience. You may begin to feel like a stepping stone or a supporting character in everyone else's hero's journey, watching them level up and move on while you remain in the forge. Your growth edge is reclaiming the center of your own narrative. You must learn to direct this potent, timeline-accelerating energy inward, ensuring that you are not just sparking transformation for passersby, but actively catalyzing your own spectacular evolution.
the_catalyst.present: You carry the signature of the Catalyst, acting as a walking plot point in the lives of those you encounter. Your energy naturally accelerates timelines, often sparking profound transformation in others shortly after they meet you. The invitation here is to ensure you are also directing this potent, world-altering energy inward, prioritizing your own evolution rather than just serving as the spark for others.
the_catalyst.fallback: As the Catalyst, your presence is an engine for profound transformation. You naturally accelerate the timelines of those around you, often acting as the exact turning point in their personal stories. Trust your deep capacity to spark change, allowing your energy to initiate powerful new chapters for both yourself and your community.

the_herald.dominant: As the Herald, your Impact Radius is defined by profound, serendipitous timing and truth-telling. You have an uncanny habit of arriving at the exact moment someone requires a pivotal piece of information, delivering the precise message they need to hear to unlock their next chapter. You are the universe's preferred messenger. The shadow of this archetype is the Cassandra complex—the heavy burden of delivering vital truths to those who are too stubborn or unready to listen. You can easily exhaust yourself trying to force the recipient to act on the wisdom you have provided. Your growth edge is complete detachment from the outcome. Your only job as the Herald is to deliver the message clearly and step back. What they do with the revelation is entirely up to them.
the_herald.present: Operating as the Herald, your impact is defined by impeccable timing and necessary truth-telling. You frequently find yourself delivering the exact message or piece of wisdom someone needs to unlock their next step. Your challenge is to completely detach from how your message is received. Your duty is simply to deliver the revelation; what others do with it is not your responsibility.
the_herald.fallback: As the Herald, your chart highlights a unique capacity for serendipitous truth-telling. You possess a remarkable knack for arriving with the exact message someone needs at the perfect time. Trust your role as a vital messenger, allowing your words and presence to unlock new pathways and provide crucial clarity for those around you.
